name: @ahr/workflow
description: Milestone 10 — Workflow Engine. Formalizes content lifecycle orchestration (reusing @ahr/cms-core's transition graph, now correctly audited — see the Milestone 4 bug fix noted in this package's README) and implements the Moderation Report review/resolution workflow (open to in_review to escalated to resolved), the first real 'approval and review flow' in this platform beyond content status. Strictly against the Frozen v1 Database Architecture - no schema changes.
